Job Description

About the Role

Oceaneering is seeking an AI Governance Intern to support the governance, delivery, operation, and adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across the enterprise. This internship provides exposure to AI governance frameworks, AI risk management, responsible AI, Microsoft Copilot, AI system reviews, AI adoption, and emerging AI technologies. The intern will work alongside the AI Governance team to help operationalize Oceaneering's AI Management System and support responsible AI at scale.

Location

Houston, TX (Hybrid)

Department

Data & Analytics, AI Governance & Adoption

Responsibilities

What You Will Do



- Support AI system intake reviews and governance assessments.
- Assist with AI System Scorecard preparation and maintenance.
- Research AI governance frameworks, standards, regulations, and emerging practices.
- Analyze AI risks, controls, and governance documentation.
- Help maintain AI inventories, governance records, and reporting metrics.
- Prepare dashboards, presentations, meeting materials, and status updates.
- Support AI literacy, communication, and adoption initiatives.
- Participate in governance workshops, AI reviews, and stakeholder meetings.
- Document governance requirements, procedures, and lessons learned.
- Assist with AI governance platform and workflow improvement activities. 

What You Will Learn



- Responsible AI and AI governance practices.
- NIST AI Risk Management Framework concepts.
- ISO/IEC 42001 AI management concepts.
- AI risk assessment and oversight.
- AI portfolio management and governance operations.
- Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and enterprise AI ecosystems.
- Policy, procedure, and governance framework development.
- Change management, AI adoption, and AI literacy programs. 

Required

 QUALIFICATIONS 



- Current undergraduate or graduate student pursuing:

- Information Systems or Computer Science
- Data Analytics
- Related field
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications.
Preferred



- Interest in AI, governance, risk, compliance, cybersecurity, or data governance.
- Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot or generative AI tools.
- Experience with Power BI, SharePoint, Excel, or Power Automate.
- Coursework related to technology, risk management, policy, project management, business or engineering, or legal studies. 

Ideal Candidate

You are curious about how organizations responsibly govern emerging technologies. You enjoy learning, researching, organizing information, collaborating with different teams, and helping transform ideas into structured processes and measurable outcomes. This role is ideal for someone interested in the intersection of technology, business, governance, risk, and AI.

Why Join Us



- Gain hands-on experience building an enterprise AI governance program.
- Work directly with leaders shaping AI governance across Oceaneering.
- Learn how enterprises evaluate, approve, monitor, and scale AI systems.
- Contribute to responsible AI adoption that creates value for customers, Oceaneers, and the business. 

About Us

Oceaneering is a global provider of engineered services and products, primarily to the offshore energy industry. We develop products and services for use throughout the lifecycle of an offshore oilfield, from drilling to decommissioning. We operate the world's premier fleet of work class ROVs. Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. We also use applied technology expertise to serve the defense, material handling, aerospace, science, and renewable energy industries.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for all positions without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other non-merit factor.
fit_why: Governance/policy work; minimal coding, little match to software stack

Join rednote's international innovation team to help build a new business and a brand-new app from the ground up. You'll work on real product challenges, contribute across the development lifecycle, and explore how AI can accelerate engineering from idea to launch.
What You'll Do Help design and develop backend services for a new app serving international users. Contribute to end-to-end feature delivery, from requirements and technical design to implementation, testing, launch, and iteration. Build and maintain APIs, data models, and business logic. Improve service performance, reliability, and maintainability. Work closely with product managers, designers, and client engineers to turn ideas into working features. Use AI tools throughout development and learn to evaluate, validate, and improve AI-generated solutions.
What We're Looking For Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Solid foundations in programming, data structures, and algorithms. Familiarity with at least one backend language, such as Java, Go, or Python. Basic understanding of HTTP, relational databases, caching, and Linux. Strong curiosity, ownership, and communication skills. Interest in AI-assisted development and a willingness to learn through hands-on work.
Nice to Have Backend development experience through internships, personal projects, or open-source contributions. Experience using AI coding tools in real projects. Familiarity with distributed systems, message queues, or container technologies. Interest in international products and user needs.
What You'll Gain Hands-on experience building a new business and app from zero to one. Opportunities to deliver complete features with guidance from the team. Practical exposure to how a forward-looking technology team integrates AI into everyday engineering. A deeper understanding of backend engineering, product development, and the trade-offs behind real-world technical decisions.

Founding AI Team Reporting Directly to Partner 

Want to build fast, ship real products, and make a visible impact at a leading private equity firm? This role is for you.

About The Role

K1 is hiring an AI Intern to help launch our internal AI function in Manhattan Beach, CA. This isn’t a standard internship. You’ll be one of our founding team members, working directly with a Founding Partner with no layers of management, no busywork, and genuine ownership from your first day. You’ll operate where AI, enterprise software, and private equity operations meet, delivering working automations and tools that create measurable impact across a portfolio of 275+ companies. Top performers can convert to full-time roles with the opportunity to build and lead their own team. The ideal candidate reflects K1’s core values: Passion, Persistence, Humility, and Excellence.

What You’ll Do



- Design, build, and deploy AI-driven automations using Claude, Microsoft 365 (Power Automate, Copilot, SharePoint), and custom integrations that replace manual work across the firm and its portfolio companies
- Quickly prototype AI tools and agents, from competitive intelligence scrapers to board-report generators, and refine them based on feedback from real users
- Assess new AI models, tools, and frameworks and turn your findings into clear, practical recommendations for the investment team
- Create internal dashboards, data pipelines, and agentic workflows that give K1’s investors a real edge
- Take on additional projects as needed

What We’re Looking For



- Recent 2026 graduate or graduating in 2027, and based in the Los Angeles area. 
- Currently pursuing (or recently completed) a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business + CS, or a related field
- At least one internship or substantial project in AI/ML, software engineering, or data science
- Daily, hands-on experience with Claude (Anthropic), including prompt engineering, multi-step workflows, and applying it to real tasks
- Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams); experience with Power Automate or Copilot Studio is a bonus
- Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript. You don’t need to be a systems engineer, but you do need to ship code that works
- A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and real curiosity about where AI is going
- Availability to work in-office in Manhattan Beach 3+ days per week; 5 days preferred. 

Why K1



- Direct access to a Founding Partner, with no bureaucracy in between
- A fast track to full-time work, including the chance to build your own team
- Exposure across 275+ enterprise software companies
- Scheduling that works around your classes
- Competitive hourly pay

About K1

K1 Investment Management is among the largest investors in small-cap, AI-powered software. We’re committed to building category leaders in technology that transform lives and industries, and we’ve invested in more than 275 companies since our founding. Based in Manhattan Beach, California, K1 partners with founders and management teams early to build AI-powered, mission-critical systems of record for enterprise customers worldwide.

Learn more at k1.com and follow K1 Investment Management on LinkedIn.

À propos d'Exegy

Exegy est un leader mondial en matière de données de marché intelligentes, de systèmes de trading avancés et de technologies évolutives. Exegy agit en tant que partenaire de confiance pour l'ensemble de l'écosystème financier : côté acheteur, côté vendeur, bourses et entreprises de technologie des services financiers à travers le monde. Dont le siège social est à St. Louis, avec des bureaux régionaux en Amérique du Nord, au Royaume-Uni/Europe et en Asie-Pacifique, Exegy dispose d'une présence mondiale pour offrir un support de classe mondiale et des services gérés à sa clientèle de participants d'élite aux marchés financiers.

Résumé du poste

Exegy est à la recherche d'un(e) stagiaire en développement logiciel pour soutenir notre équipe d'ingénierie dans le développement de logiciels en Python, d'outils d'automatisation et d'applications internes visant à améliorer l'efficacité, la fiabilité et l'évolutivité de nos processus technologiques et opérationnels.

Il s'agit d'un poste de stage coopératif de 4 mois (avec possibilité de prolongation à 8 mois), basé à Montréal, pour la session Hiver 2026–2027. Nous recherchons des étudiant(e)s en fin de parcours (S3 ou équivalent). La maîtrise du français est requise pour ce poste.

L'étudiant(e) acquerra une expérience pratique en développement logiciel dans un environnement d'ingénierie professionnel, en travaillant aux côtés de développeurs et d'ingénieurs systèmes expérimentés sur des projets concrets. Le rôle mettra fortement l'accent sur le développement Python et l'automatisation, notamment l'identification de processus manuels ou répétitifs pouvant être optimisés par le biais de logiciels.

Responsabilités

 - Développer, tester, déboguer et maintenir des scripts Python, des applications et des outils d'automatisation

 - Concevoir et améliorer des flux de travail automatisés afin de réduire les tâches manuelles d'ingénierie et d'exploitation

 - Créer des outils et utilitaires internes pour soutenir le provisionnement, la configuration, la surveillance, les tests et la gestion des systèmes

 - Travailler avec des API, des données structurées et des systèmes logiciels existants pour intégrer et automatiser des processus

 - Participer au développement et à la maintenance des logiciels utilisés pour soutenir les plateformes technologiques haute performance d'Exegy

 - Diagnostiquer les problèmes logiciels et contribuer à l'analyse des causes profondes et à la résolution de problèmes techniques

 - Rédiger un code propre, maintenable et bien documenté en suivant les bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel établies

 - Développer des tests unitaires et participer aux revues de code afin d'améliorer la qualité et la fiabilité des logiciels

 - Maintenir la documentation technique pour les applications, les scripts d'automatisation, les flux de travail et les processus d'ingénierie

 - Collaborer avec les développeurs, les ingénieurs systèmes et d'autres équipes techniques pour comprendre les besoins et les traduire en solutions logicielles concrètes

 - Rechercher et évaluer de nouvelles technologies, outils et approches susceptibles d'améliorer l'automatisation et l'efficacité de l'ingénierie

 - Participer aux réunions d'équipe, aux discussions techniques et au cycle de développement logiciel dans son ensemble

Profil recherché

 - En fin de parcours dans un programme de génie informatique, de génie logiciel, d'informatique ou dans une discipline technique connexe (S3 ou équivalent)

 - Expérience en programmation Python acquise dans le cadre de cours, de projets personnels, de stages ou d'expériences professionnelles antérieures

 - Compréhension des fondamentaux du développement logiciel, notamment les structures de données, la programmation orientée objet, les tests et le débogage

 - Familiarité avec Git ou un autre système de contrôle de version

 - Intérêt pour l'automatisation logicielle, les outils internes, le DevOps, l'ingénierie des systèmes ou les technologies d'infrastructure

 - Solides compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes

 - Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies et à travailler en collaboration dans un environnement technique

 - Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, en français et en anglais

Une exposition à Linux, aux API REST, au CI/CD, aux technologies cloud, à l'automatisation d'infrastructure ou aux technologies financières est un atout, mais n'est pas requise.

Ce stage offre l'opportunité de contribuer directement à des initiatives d'ingénierie orientées production, tout en développant une expérience pratique en développement Python, en automatisation, en intégration de systèmes et en pratiques d'ingénierie modernes.

_______________________________________________________________________________

About Exegy

Exegy is a global leader in intelligent market data, advanced trading systems, and future-proof technology. Exegy serves as a trusted partner to the complete ecosystem of the buy-side, sell-side, exchanges, and financial services technology firms around the globe. Headquartered in St. Louis with regional offices in North America, the UK/Europe and Asia Pacific, Exegy has the global footprint to deliver world-class support and managed services to its customer base of elite financial market participants.

Job Summary

Exegy is seeking a Software Developer Intern to support our engineering team in developing Python-based software, automation tools, and internal applications that improve the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of our technology and operational processes.

This is a 4-month co-op position (with the possibility of extension to 8 months) based in Montreal, for the Winter 2026–2027 term. We are looking for students in the final stages of their program (S3 or equivalent).

The student will gain hands-on software development experience in a professional engineering environment, working alongside experienced developers and systems engineers on real-world projects. The role will have a strong emphasis on Python development and automation, including identifying manual or repetitive processes that can be streamlined through software.

Responsibilities

 - Develop, test, debug, and maintain Python scripts, applications, and automation tools

 - Design and improve automated workflows that reduce manual engineering and operational tasks

 - Build internal tools and utilities to support provisioning, configuration, monitoring, testing, and system management

 - Work with APIs, structured data, and existing software systems to integrate and automate processes

 - Assist with developing and maintaining software used to support Exegy's high-performance technology platforms

 - Troubleshoot software issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and technical problem solving

 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established software development practices

 - Develop unit tests and participate in code reviews to improve software quality and reliability

 - Maintain technical documentation for applications, automation scripts, workflows, and engineering processes

 - Collaborate with software developers, systems engineers, and other technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into practical software solutions

 - Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches that could improve automation and engineering efficiency

 - Participate in team meetings, technical discussions, and the broader software development lifecycle

Our Ideal Candidate

 - Nearing the end of a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline (S3 or equivalent)

 - Experience programming in Python through coursework, personal projects, internships, or previous work experience

 - Understanding of software development fundamentals, including data structures, object-oriented programming, testing, and debugging

 - Familiarity with Git or another source-control system

 - Interest in software automation, internal tooling, DevOps, systems engineering, or infrastructure technologies

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work collaboratively in a technical team environment

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

Exposure to Linux, REST APIs, CI/CD, cloud technologies, infrastructure automation, or financial technology is beneficial but not required.

This internship provides the opportunity to contribute directly to production-oriented engineering initiatives while developing practical experience in Python software development, automation, systems integration, and modern engineering practices.
fit_why: Python automation and software role fits, but French fluency is required
